Introduction

Kimura Masaya was born on October 10th, 1997, in Aichi, Japan. He is the lead vocalist, lead dancer, and leader of INI.

He made his debut in INI on November 3rd, 2021, with the single "A". His final rank on Produce 101 Japan (Season 2) was 1st.
